<a id="GitCommandLine"></a>

### Git's command line

`GitCommandLine` · `src/repository.ts:306`

The commands that say which branch is checked out, push it and follow it, fetch another and list the files that differ since the two parted.

Source: Git manual: git (--version), git-rev-parse (--abbrev-ref), git-push (--set-upstream), git-fetch, git-diff (--name-only, A...B: since the merge base), git-checkout, git-merge (--ff-only) · `https://git-scm.com/docs/git-diff`

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `program` | `git` | Git's command line |
| `version` | `--version` | Says which Git this is: it answers when Git is installed |
| `revParse` | `rev-parse` | Says what a name stands for |
| `abbreviated` | `--abbrev-ref` | The short name of a reference: the branch's |
| `head` | `HEAD` | What is checked out |
| `detached` | `HEAD` | What rev-parse --abbrev-ref says when no branch is checked out |
| `push` | `push` | Sends a branch to a remote |
| `upstream` | `--set-upstream` | The branch follows the one it was sent to |
| `remote` | `origin` | The remote the repository came from |
| `fetch` | `fetch` | Brings a branch of a remote |
| `fetched` | `FETCH_HEAD` | What was just fetched |
| `diff` | `diff` | Shows what differs |
| `names` | `--name-only` | Only the paths of the files that differ |
| `since` | `...` | Between two names: what the second changes since it parted from the first |
| `checkout` | `checkout` | Checks a branch out |
| `merge` | `merge` | Joins another history into the branch checked out |
| `forwardOnly` | `--ff-only` | Only by moving the branch forward: refused if it would need a merge commit |

<a id="GitHubAutoMerge"></a>

### GitHub's ways of asking a merge once it holds

`GitHubAutoMerge` · `src/repository.ts:503`

GitHub's command line asks it by GraphQL (enablePullRequestAutoMerge); a session of Claude Code reaches GitHub through a proxy that refuses GraphQL and offers a route of its own, PUT on the pull request's ccr/auto_merge, as it says when GraphQL is called.

Source: GitHub CLI manual: gh pr merge (--auto, --merge, --squash, --rebase, --repo); the proxy of a Claude Code session, answering a call to GraphQL: PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{n}/ccr/auto_merge · `https://cli.github.com/manual/gh_pr_merge`

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `pr` | `pr` | The commands of pull requests |
| `merge` | `merge` | Merges one, or asks it merged |
| `auto` | `--auto` | Once it holds: its checks passed |
| `byMerge` | `--merge` | By a merge commit |
| `bySquash` | `--squash` | Squashed into one commit |
| `byRebase` | `--rebase` | Its commits rebased |
| `repo` | `--repo` | The repository, owner/name |
| `route` | `/ccr/auto_merge` | After the pull request: the route of the proxy that asks GitHub to merge it once it holds |
| `method` | `merge_method` | How it is merged, in the body of that route |

- Maintained by: trame
- Serves: [A published value is cited, not copied](product.md#CitedNotCopied)

## Architecture decision

<a id="RepositoryThroughItsApi"></a>

### A repository is set by its project's graph

`RepositoryThroughItsApi` · `src/repository.ts:629` · status: **held**

The settings of a repository are a decision of the project's graph, applied through a port of the library and read back: realized once for a machine (GitHub's command line) and once in memory.

Context: A repository's settings decide what reaches its main branch: set by hand in GitHub's pages, nothing says why, and nothing tells when they drift from what the project decided.

Consequences: A project decides its settings (RepositorySettings) and applies them by a program of its SDLC that a shipment deploys, which reads them back and compares them (RepositoryCompared); its scenarios play that program with the repository kept in memory, and a check reads the repository as it is.

| Rejected | Why |
|---|---|
| A script the graph writes, which an administrator runs | nothing reads the repository back, and nothing records who set it |
| A writer in ci | a program that calls GitHub is code a project runs and verifies, not a file a place runs |

- Decided by: trame
- Serves: [Ports of the platform, realized once](product.md#RealizedOnce)
- Applied by: [How GitHub merges a pull request](#MergeMethods), [The parts of a repository's settings](#RepositoryParts), [A repository compared with its settings](#RepositoryCompared), [A repository on GitHub](#RepositoryApi), [GitHub's command line](#GitHubCliRepository), [The repositories a scenario keeps](#RepositoryKept), [A repository kept in memory](#RepositoryInMemory)

<a id="GitHubCliRepository"></a>

### GitHub's command line

`GitHubCliRepository` · `src/repository.ts:222`

Applies the settings by gh api, with the token of whoever runs it: the merge methods, the automatic merge and the deletion of merged branches; the ruleset named after the branch, created or replaced, whose rule of pull requests asks nothing but the approvals decided (GitHub's defaults otherwise); the pages built by a workflow, created or replaced. Reads back the repository, the rules in force on the branch, and its pages when asked. A call that fails stops what applies, and is answered.

- Owner: trame
- Parameters: `api` ← [GitHub's API for a repository](#GitHubRepositoryApi) · `cli` ← [Node.js command line and child processes](system.md#NodeCli) · `events` ← [Node.js events](system.md#NodeEvents) · `exit` ← [Exit status](system.md#ExitStatus) · `methods` ← [How GitHub merges a pull request](#MergeMethods) · `texts` ← [Texts](algebra.md#Texts) · `values` ← [Types of values](algebra.md#ValueTypes)
- Body: `./code/tooling/github-cli-repository.ts` (typescript)
